experiments.name: Scroll Narrative
experiments.problem: Sequential ideas dumped as a wall of text lose causal order.
experiments.short: A vertical essay whose stages pin while a diagram is constructed in causal order.

experiments.name: Interactive Knowledge Graph
experiments.problem: Relationship networks are unreadable when every node is equally present.
experiments.short: An SVG graph that stays quiet until hover focuses a neighborhood and click opens a dossier.

experiments.name: Progressive Timeline
experiments.problem: Chronologies shown all at once flatten sequence and overwhelm detail.
experiments.short: Overview → event → detail. Scrub or scroll reveals events in time.

experiments.name: Animated Process Diagram
experiments.problem: Processes described as A → B → C hide activation, change, and emergence.
experiments.short: The animation is the explanation: signal propagates, a node activates, a result emerges.

experiments.name: Spatial Information Map
experiments.problem: Hierarchical menus hide neighborhood and make overview feel like a table of contents.
experiments.short: A pan-and-zoom field of concepts. Distance implies relatedness; zoom is reading.

experiments.name: Interactive Comparison
experiments.motion: corresponding parts align or peel apart
experiments.problem: Two systems described in adjacent paragraphs cannot be compared on shared structure.
experiments.short: Two models on shared axes; a slider isolates difference.

experiments.name: Negative-Feedback Loop
experiments.problem: Feedback is often drawn as a pretty circle that does not encode sensor, integrator, effector, or variable.
experiments.short: A labeled control loop. Disturb the variable and watch the effector oppose the change.

experiments.name: Layered Image Annotation
experiments.problem: A caption under an image cannot point at structure inside the image.
experiments.short: Numbered hotspots on one image; callouts layer on; unused regions dim.

experiments.name: Kinetic Typography
experiments.problem: Motion applied to type often decorates instead of encoding hierarchy and sequence.
experiments.short: A short statement whose entrance order and emphasis are the argument.

experiments.name: Infinite Canvas
experiments.information: spatial clusters without a forced reading order
experiments.problem: Page scroll forces a single reading order onto material that is spatial and clustered.
experiments.short: An unbounded canvas of notes and diagrams. Clusters emerge as you pan.
